title: Correct charge q
description: Essential: The answer for part (1) must be q = (√3 m g L²) / (3 k Q).

title: Equilibrium force resolution
description: Important: The solution must resolve forces on the ball at A, equating the horizontal electric force to the horizontal component of gravity (mg tanθ).

title: Kinetic energy at C
description: Essential: The answer for part (2) must be E_kC = (√3/2) m g L + (1/2) m v₀².

title: Use of equal potentials
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must recognize that points A and C are at the same distance from Q, so the electric potential and electric potential energy are equal.

title: Work-energy theorem application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the work-energy theorem, accounting for work done by gravity and electric forces.

title: Kinetic energy at B
description: Essential: The answer for part (3) must be E_kB = (1/2) m v₀² - (√3/12) m g L.

title: Electric potential energy change
description: Important: For part (3), the solution must calculate the change in electric potential energy from A to B using the given work formula or U = kQq/r.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the work done by the electric field is given the wrong sign (e.g., using U_B - U_A instead of U_A - U_B).

title: Geometry for distances
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly calculate geometric distances (e.g., OB = L/2, AC = √3 L) using the 30° angle and given lengths.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The final expressions for energy and charge have correct dimensional units.
